title: Ailín Pérez Faces Norma Dumont in Las Vegas, Sparking Tension
seoTitle: Ailín Pérez vs Norma Dumont: Tension in Las Vegas
subtitle: The clash between the South Americans takes center stage after a provocation involving condoms and dollar bills at the weigh-in
excerpt: The matchup between Ailín Pérez and Norma Dumont reaches its peak in Las Vegas, after an unusual provocation at the official weigh-in heightened tension.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The fight between Argentina's Ailín Pérez and Brazil's Norma Dumont will take center stage at UFC Vegas 121, following a verbal and physical confrontation during the official weigh-in, when Dumont threw condoms and dollar bills at her rival.

The provocation at the official weigh-in

At the weigh-in held on the eve of the fight, both athletes appeared with their countries' flags. Dumont, pulling a strip of condoms from her pants, threw them at Pérez, who picked them up and showed them to the crowd. Next, the Brazilian threw dollar bills, intensifying the already existing rivalry between the two.

Ailín Pérez's recent run

Pérez enters the matchup with a record of 13 wins and 2 losses in the UFC, including six consecutive triumphs. Among her recent achievements are victories over Ashlee Evans-Smith, Lucie Pudilova, Joselyne Edwards, Karol Rosa, Darya Zheleznyakova, and, in February, a unanimous decision win against Macy Chiasson, which placed her among the division's top six.

Preparation and motivation of the Argentine

Recovered from a leg injury that sidelined her after the fight against Chiasson, Pérez used the time to improve her boxing and strengthen her mental game, relying on support from a psychologist, her father, and her team. She highlights a phrase from her son, who calls her a "legend," as fuel to pursue the belt.

Expectations for the octagon clash

Pérez claims she is ready to end the fight in the first round with a head kick, while Dumont, an experienced fighter with nine UFC wins, looks to regain supremacy after a recent loss to Joselyne Edwards. Both arrive with aggressive styles and a history of decisions that could repeat themselves.

Possible ranking implications

A victory for Pérez would extend her streak to seven consecutive wins and bring her even closer to a title shot. For Dumont, a triumph would represent the chance to regain her position in the rankings and resume the race for a contender spot.

With information from Infobae, TN.
